title: Ghana Ludo
imageAlt: A Ludo board mid-round with red, gold, green and blue pieces round a black star, beside the headline Ludo with friends, no server
description: *Ghana Ludo* is a **browser board game** with the Ghanaian house rules: besides the ordinary kick, a piece can knock an opponent out **backwards, sideways across a house, or inside their own house**. Play alone against bots, pass one phone round, or invite friends to their own phones.

Online play needs **no server**. The phones pair with a QR code or a link and talk directly over **WebRTC**, while the host's phone holds the one true board. I shaped that design as a **reusable module**, so future games share the same **real-time synchronization**.
